title: Adjunction determinant and base change for a flat local complete intersection
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme (one admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]) and $p:W\to S$ a flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] finitely presented (locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]) morphism whose nonempty geometric fibres [def-weil-geometric-fibre] are pure of dimension $d\geq0$ (every irreducible component has dimension $d$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]). Assume that locally on $W$ and $S$ there is a factorization $U\xrightarrow{i}P\to S$ with $P$ open in $\mathbf A^n_S$ and $i$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose ideal $I$ is locally generated by a regular sequence of length $c=n-d$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Write $C=I/I^2$ on $U$, $V=i^*\Omega^1_{P/S}$, and $K_i=(\bigwedge^c C)^\vee\otimes\bigwedge^n V$, where the superscript $\vee$ means $\mathcal Hom(-,\mathcal O_U)$ and $i^*$ is module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Relative differentials mean the sheaf associated on affine charts with the module of Kähler differentials [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]; exterior powers are sheafifications of the module exterior powers [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra]. These $K_i$ have canonical transition isomorphisms, independent of presentations and satisfying the cocycle condition, hence define an invertible module $K_{W/S}$ [def-sc-invertible-module] even if $W\to S$ is nonseparated. They admit canonical identifications $i_*K_i\cong\mathcal Ext^c_P(i_*\mathcal O_U,\Omega^n_{P/S})$ [def-weil-pbc-sheaf-ext]. On every separated open chart $U/S$, the complex $K_{W/S}|_U[d]$ is the relative dualizing complex: it is the object locally represented by $R\mathcal Hom_P(i_*\mathcal O_U,\Omega^n_{P/S}[n])$, regarded as a complex on $U$. For every scheme morphism $S'\to S$, with $W'=W\times_SS'$ and projection $g:W'\to W$, the base-changed presentations have the same adjunction construction and the resulting canonical isomorphism $g^*K_{W/S}\cong K_{W'/S'}$ is compatible with composition of base changes. On the smooth locus [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] this construction is canonically $\Omega^d_{W/S}$.

proof.text: The regular equations are Koszul-regular by [lem-weil-pbc-regular-sequence-koszul-regular], and their classes give the conormal basis by [lem-weil-pbc-regular-sequence-conormal-free]. Apply [lem-trf-lci-determinant-descent-smooth] to these presentations: set $K_{W/S}=\det L_{W/S}$. Its specified maps $\alpha_i$ identify the local $K_i$ with this invertible module, and its transitions give presentation independence and the cocycle condition on all overlaps, including for nonseparated $W/S$.

Apply [lem-trf-lci-koszul-duality-determinant-comparison] on each presentation. It identifies the full ambient derived Hom with $i_*K_i[-c]$. Its degree-$c$ consequence [lem-trf-lci-adjunction-top-ext] supplies precisely $i_*K_i\cong\mathcal Ext^c_P(i_*\mathcal O_U,\Omega^n_{P/S})$, with the normalized map.

source.place: Tag 0BQZ, lemma-regular-immersion-ext, tensored with the ambient top-differential line.

proof.text: On any separated open chart $T/S$, flatness and local finite presentation restrict from $W/S$, and the base remains Noetherian. The conditional dualizing assertion of [lem-trf-lci-koszul-duality-determinant-comparison] therefore applies to $T$. Since $n-c=d$, its normalized derived comparisons identify the relative dualizing complex with $K_{W/S}|_T[d]$ and have exactly the transitions of step 1.

source.place: Tags 0BZI, 0BZJ, canonical top-differential normalization and the one-variable refinement calculation; perfect.tex, Tag 0FJM.

proof.text: For any $S'\to S$, apply [lem-trf-flat-lci-presentation-base-change]. Its pulled-back equations are regular at source points and Koszul-regular on the ambient charts, and its conormal comparison gives the same rank $c$. Hence [lem-trf-lci-determinant-descent-smooth] also constructs $K_{W'/S'}=\det L_{W'/S'}$ without a Noetherian assumption on $S'$. The specified coherent determinant comparison in the base-change node identifies $g^*K_{W/S}$ with this line; its local expression is exactly pullback of the adjunction formula. Its identity and composition laws give the required base-change compatibility.

source.place: Tag 0FUD, remark-relative-regular-immersion-elements; local conormal freeness and Koszul exactness.

proof.text: Finally [lem-trf-lci-determinant-descent-smooth] identifies $K_{W/S}$ on each smooth open with $\bigwedge^d\Omega^1_{W/S}=\Omega^d_{W/S}$, using its specified exact-conormal normalization. This is the canonical smooth comparison of the construction in step 1.
